label: LoRA Showcase: Style Lab
description: A controlled A/B bench for style-mover LoRAs: the same kind of stranger on the same night street every time, with only the style engine changing. Each variant is one base-model family — Flux.1 cyberpunk-anime and sci-fi environments, SDXL neon cyberpunk, SD 1.5 animation and figure looks — so a comparison never accidentally crosses families. The drawn movers ride the loras output into LoRA Apply and heal by AIR urn if the file is missing.
prefix: One stranger seen full-figure on one street corner after dark, with a single style engine allowed to rewrite the whole frame. The staging is held deliberately constant and the scene dimensions deliberately few: the look is meant to be the only variable between renders.
suffix: The style engine owns the render: let it set line, shading and palette from edge to edge rather than sitting as a filter over a photograph. Underneath it the figure stays anatomically sound and the street stays readable, so the comparison is about the look and nothing else.
negative: child, underage, deformed, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, caption overlay, lowres, jpeg artifacts
